summary: chore(content-server): remove dependencies the Backbone client used
description:
Because:

* FXA-14816 deleted the Backbone client and its webpack config, so 43
  content-server dependencies have no user.
* Other packages used some of them through root hoisting.

This commit:

* Removes those dependencies from the content-server package.json.
* Declares @types/chai at the root, the class-properties Babel plugin in
  fxa-settings, and got in functional-tests, where each one is used.
* Updates yarn.lock.

Closes FXA-10275
